output_text:
P2P baby monitor web app using WebRTC (PeerJS) + Vite + TypeScript.

Module structure: Each station is self-contained with `init*` function returning `CleanupHandle`. Cleanup pattern: All stations MUST return `{ cleanup: () => void }` for proper teardown. Error handling: Use `querySelectorOrThrow()` - never silently fail on missing DOM. Never use `querySelector` without null check (use `querySelectorOrThrow`). URL state: Stations sync state via URL params (`station`, `roomId`). Wake Lock: Always request on station init, release in cleanup. Never leave MediaStream tracks running after cleanup. Don't hardcode PeerJS peer IDs in parent station (random ID, call by room). Room IDs: `WordWordWord1234` format (`dictionary.ts`). HTTPS dev mode: `bun run dev:https` generates self-signed certs. HTTPS dev mode note: Mobile testing requires HTTPS; `bun run dev:https -- --host <REDACTED_IP>`.

Stations:
- Baby Station (`src/baby-station.ts`): Camera/mic streaming, QR code, settings drawer; device selection, stream management; Back camera default: prefers `facingMode: environment` on mobile.
- Parent Station (`src/parent-station.ts`): Receives stream, audio/motion meters, alerts; audio meter scaling (`level * 3`); reconnection logic; PeerJS retry timing: waits 5s+ between retries (PeerJS connection timeout). Motion detection: frame differencing on 160x120 downsampled video, 2-second alert cooldown.
- Shared utilities (`src/utils.ts`): Wake lock, media stream helpers.
- Motion detection (`src/motion-detection.ts`): Frame differencing, grayscale conversion, threshold.
- Routing/state (`src/main.ts`): URL params, history API; entry routing/URL state/landing page.
- Room ID generator (`src/dictionary.ts`): word list + ID generator.
UI/CSS/Alerts: Full-screen video + slide-up sett
